card.name: Looking at samples under a microscope
card.fires_on: The word "under" (or the next word, like "a" or a magnification) right after a tissue sample is viewed or examined, just before "a microscope". Also fires on magnification numbers after "under".

modes.label: under before microscope
modes.description: The word "under" after a verb like viewed, examined or looks at, in a biopsy or pathology setting.
modes.example: A pathologist views the bone marrow, blood, and bone<< under>> a microscope to see if the cancer has

modes.label: after under, before microscope
modes.description: The article "a" or the viewing verb that comes just before or after "under" in the same phrase.
modes.example: A sample of the breast discharge to look at under<< a>> microscope - Blood

modes.label: magnification
modes.description: The slot after "under" where a magnification such as 40x or 2500X follows.
modes.example: This is a live image of the of Diatom Arachnoidiscus under<< >>40x magnification.

card.writes: It pushes away words like cells, stains, slides and pathology, so it seems to mark that the microscope phrase is not finished by those words.
card.plain: It lights up when a text says a tissue sample is looked at under a microscope.
